days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Sesto Calende
stops.detail: Leaving Lake Maggiore, near Sesto Calende, the Ticino crosses the entire Lombard plain, creating its own valley, before flowing into the Po a few kilometers south of Pavia, at the Ponte della Becca.

stops.name: Somma Lombardo
stops.detail: From Lake Maggiore to Somma Lombardo, the Ticino flows forming meanders set in deep gorges, carved into moraine deposits.

stops.name: Ponte Vecchio
stops.detail: The institutional headquarters and the technical and administrative offices of the entity that manages the park are located in Magenta, in the locality of Ponte Vecchio.

stops.name: Motta Visconti
stops.detail: From Somma Lombardo to Motta Visconti, the river changes its appearance: the riverbed widens to cover a width of about three kilometers, forming numerous gravel or sand islands.
